title: How reduce processes elements
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[10, 20, 30] reduce ((element, acc = 0) -> acc + element)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[10, 20, 30] reduce ((element, acc = 0) -> acc + element)

explanation.approach: Each element gets added to `acc`, which starts at 0. After the first pass, acc is 10. After the second, 30. After the third, 60.
